attempts.summary: Configured node1 as an NFSv4 server exporting /srv/nfs/shared to node2 and node3 over the cluster's only available network (10.100.145.0/24 — no separate dedicated storage network existed in this topology since each node has a single NIC). Created the sharedops user/group (UID/GID 4200) identically on all three nodes, set /srv/nfs/shared to sharedops:sharedops mode 2770, and mounted it at /mnt/shared via NFSv4.2 on both clients with persistent fstab entries. Verified bidirectional, immediate file visibility between node2 and node3 with ownership/permission preservation. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all three nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of NFS services, exports, mounts, and data (including successful cross-client writes/reads after each restart).
